instruction: A night forest of giant bioluminescent mushrooms: towering caps glowing teal, violet and amber, clusters of small toadstools, curling ferns, mossy fallen logs, twisted tree silhouettes, drifting glowing spores, a winding path of luminous stepping stones, and a shallow pool reflecting the mushroom light. The caps pulse softly as spores float upward.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Glowing Mushroom Forest. A night forest of giant bioluminescent mushrooms: towering caps glowing teal, violet and amber, clusters of small toadstools, curling ferns, mossy fallen logs, twisted tree silhouettes, drifting glowing spores, a winding path of luminous stepping stones, and a shallow pool reflecting the mushroom light. The caps pulse softly as spores float upward. Style: bioluminescent fantasy. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
